summary: Tested new coupon `max_uses_per_user` feature end-to-end. Backend: 7 new pytest cases (create/update persistence, validate enforcement, order-creation enforcement, per-user isolation across emails, null=unlimited, and coexistence with total max_uses) all pass. Existing test_coupon_restriction.py (9 tests) still pass — no regressions. Frontend: verified `data-testid=coupon-form-max-uses-per-user` input exists alongside `coupon-form-max-uses`; created coupon with per-user=3 saves correctly, row summary shows '3x por usuário', and edit dialog pre-populates the value.
critical_code_review_comments: coupons_routes.validate_coupon: per-user counter uses `if max_per_user and email` — treats max_uses_per_user=0 same as unset. Acceptable per spec (empty/null=unlimited) but worth noting: an admin setting `0` intending 'zero uses' would silently be unlimited. Consider `is not None` if 0 should mean blocked.

orders_routes.create_order (~L286): the per-user count is checked against current orders, but the request itself then inserts a new order in WAITING status. If two requests race, both could pass the check and exceed the limit. Low priority (checkout race, small window) but not atomic.
Same race exists for `max_uses` total (pre-existing, not introduced by this change).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (field renders, saves, persists, list summary correct)

seed_data_creation: None persisted — test coupons/orders/users cleaned up in fixtures; the UI test coupon was manually deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_coupon_per_user_limit.py fixtures depend on active lot for ticket_type_id=tkt_4abdb0d16618 and admin login. If future changes touch coupon logic, run both test_coupon_restriction.py and test_coupon_per_user_limit.py together.
